newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia university closed after student riots.
newsitem.headline: Zambia university closed after student riots.

text.p: The University of Zambia shut down indefinitely on Thursday after five days of student riots.
Students began stoning vehicles and vandalising campus property on Sunday night in protest against delays in the payment of meal and book allowances.
"Given the situation...the (university) senate has decided to close the university with immediate effect," campus administration said in a statement.
Government paid out meal allowances on Tuesday and promised to pay book monies this month.
Police on Monday arrested 10 students at Zambia's biggest university after using teargas and batons to break up street riots. Thirteen students were expelled from the university.
Last November the university was closed for several weeks when students protested against the way general elections, boycotted by seven opposition parties, had been organised.
